scope: Small natural speech recognition and natural-video tracking computation-control experiments. Not any-to-any generation, not a new foundation model, not original native owner integration.

speech.pretraining_exposure: Gate fit/test speakers are disjoint; exposure of these public recordings during upstream Whisper pretraining is not established
speech.gate_feature: Mean segment log probability after actual greedy decoding
speech.gate_condition: Run an additional beam-5 decode when greedy mean log probability is below fitted threshold
speech.fit_objective: Mean clipped utterance WER plus 0.01 times observed fit wall seconds; minimize with lower threshold as tie break
speech.test_order: Rotate arm execution order by utterance index
speech.transcript_visibility: Reference passed only to offline fit/evaluation scorer, never to ASR or gate

video.frame_alignment: Follow each source yml start index, one-based; first GT row initializes that frame. David start=300, other sequences start=1.
video.gate_condition: Global template search after local NCC falls below fitted threshold
video.fit_objective: Mean IoU minus 0.02 times global-search fraction; maximize, lower threshold tie break
video.template: Actual first-frame annotated target patch; frozen throughout sequence
video.truth_visibility: Only first-frame initialization box is public; later annotated boxes are read by scorer after TRACK.json is complete
video.limitation: Two test videos, different sequences; frames are not independent sources and no statistical population-superiority claim is allowed

experiment_stopping_rule: One frozen fit-and-test run; no changing selection, thresholds or metrics after test scoring; retain failures and negative results
numeric_results: Report observed quality/cost separately; no guaranteed improvement or global-optimality claim
training_claim: Only small gates are fitted. Whisper parameters are unchanged; visual template is initialized from the permitted first annotation.
